pair.missing_address: Please fill in the IP address of your SolarAssistant device.
pair.connection_failed: Could not connect. Check the IP address and password and make sure Homey is on the same network.
pair.no_devices_found: No SolarAssistant device was found automatically. Please fill in the IP address manually.
pair.password_rejected: The password was rejected. Enter the local password set on the SolarAssistant unit (not your solar-assistant.io login). If you have not set one yet, do that first.
pair.unreachable: Cannot reach the SolarAssistant unit at that address. Check the IP address and that Homey is on the same network.
pair.unexpected_response: That address did not answer like a SolarAssistant unit. Check the IP address, and make sure a local password has been set on the unit.
pair.found_but_rejected: A device was found on the network, but the password was rejected. Enter the local password set on the SolarAssistant unit (not your solar-assistant.io login), or fill in the IP address manually.
